scientific_integrity: The previously published characteristic-zero double and quadruple counts and classical line equations are acknowledged antecedents. The result asserted here is the universal list of exceptional odd reduction primes and the complete Frobenius spectra of the reduced crossing strata. Independent priority and scientific audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Reduced intersections of the 28 geometric bitangent lines of the literal Fermat plane quartic only; finite fields of odd characteristic. The nonreduced singular scheme, characteristic two, and twisted forms are not classified.
title: Exceptional primes and Frobenius spectra for the Fermat quartic bitangent arrangement
